info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Tasks API
Return the data for all Tasks

params.name: assignee_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single User or Contact. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Task. The list will be filtered to include only the Task records with the matching property.

params.name: assignee_type
params.description: Filter Task records to those with a specific assignee. Must be passed if filtering by assignee.

params.name: assigner_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single User. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Task. The list will be filtered to include only the Task records with the matching property.

params.name: cascading_source_id
params.description: Filter Task records to those with a parent task that has the specified ID.

params.name: client_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Contact. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Task. The list will be filtered to include only the Task records with the matching property.

params.name: complete
params.description: Filter Task records to those which are complete or not.

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter Task records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: due_at_from
params.description: Start of date range when querying by due_at in a range. (Expects an ISO-8601 date).

params.name: due_at_present
params.description: Filter Task records to those that have a due date specified, or not.

params.name: due_at_to
params.description: End of date range when querying by due_at in a range. (Expects an ISO-8601 date).

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter Task records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of Task records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: matter_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single Matter. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Task. The list will be filtered to include only the Task records with the matching property.

params.name: order
params.description: Orders the Task records by the given field. Default: `id(asc)`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: permission
params.description: Filter Task records to those with the given permission. Returns all tasks by default.

params.name: priority
params.description: Filter Task records to those with the given priority.

params.name: query
params.description: Wildcard search for `name` or `description` matching a given string.

params.name: responsible_attorney_id
params.description: Filter Task records to those that have an associated matter with a responsible attorney ID.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter Task records to those with the given status. Users without advanced tasks enabled may only specify 'complete' or 'pending'.

params.name: statuses[]
params.description: Filter Task records to those with the given statuses. Users without advanced tasks enabled may only specify 'complete' or 'pending'.

params.name: statute_of_limitations
params.description: Filter Task records to those which are a statute of limitations or not.

params.name: task_type_id
params.description: The unique identifier for a single TaskType. Use the keyword `null` to match those without a Task. The list will be filtered to include only the Task records with the matching property.

params.name: time_entries_present
params.description: Filter Task records to those that have associated time entries, or not.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter Task records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).
